publication.title: QueDI: From Knowledge Graph Querying to Data Visualization

adjudication.basis: QueDI offers iterative facet/controlled-language RDF querying followed by table manipulation and exportable charts. It is a complete exploratory workflow beyond isolated question answering, documented with accuracy and usability evaluations.

query_languages.name: SQL
query_languages.role: local table manipulation after RDF retrieval

tasks: Six DBpedia tasks;11 technical and12 lay participants

descriptions.interaction: Focus-based facet selections including direct/inverse relations, controlled-language query/refinement, optional/union/filter/negation patterns, then table aggregation/filter/sort and chart configuration/export.
descriptions.guidance: Valid focus-dependent suggestions, intermediate results, autocomplete, language-aware label fallback and data-compatible chart enablement. NL is generated controlled language, not arbitrary free-text input.
descriptions.visualisation: Tabular results and customisable maps/timelines/charts/media/treemaps; export image or dynamic HTML5 component storing queries.
descriptions.backend: Client-side JavaScript/HTML/CSS, generated SPARQL to CORS-enabled endpoints and SQL for local table manipulation; DBpedia and several cultural/library endpoints.

resources.notes: GitHub shows the exact reported controllets/splod-controllet path with splodjs and HTML component files. QueDI branding or a complete deployable application is not established by that directory alone.
Visible page identifies a reusable datalet creator and loading/query/filter/visualise workflow at the paper-reported splod-visualization URL; complete QueDI query workflow not exercised.
